Bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial Spot
Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease that causes small dark lesions on tomato leaves and can reduce plant health.
symptoms: Small dark brown or black spots on leaves
Lesions may enlarge under favorable conditions
management: Remove and dispose of severely infected plant material
Avoid working with plants when foliage is wet
Use locally approved disease-management products according to their labels

Early_blight.name: Early Blight
Early_blight.description: A fungal disease that commonly produces dark lesions with concentric ring patterns on older tomato leaves.
symptoms: Dark brown spots on older leaves
Premature leaf drop in severe infections
management: Use locally approved fungicides according to their labels

Late_blight.name: Late Blight
Late_blight.description: A destructive disease that can rapidly damage tomato foliage and fruit under favorable environmental conditions.
symptoms: Rapid browning or collapse of leaf tissue
Dark lesions may occur on stems
Fruit may develop dark, firm lesions
management: Use locally approved disease-management products according to their labels

Leaf_Mold.name: Leaf Mold
Leaf_Mold.description: A fungal disease that primarily affects tomato leaves, especially under humid conditions.
symptoms: Yellow patches on upper leaf surfaces
Olive or grayish fungal growth on lower leaf surfaces
Leaves may curl or dry under severe infection
management: Use locally approved fungicides according to their labels

Septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
Septoria_leaf_spot.description: A fungal disease that produces numerous small circular lesions, often beginning on older leaves.
symptoms: Lower leaves are often affected first
management: Use locally approved fungicides according to their labels

Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite.name: Spider Mites
Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite.description: Tiny pests that feed on plant tissue and can cause stippling, discoloration, and leaf damage.
symptoms: Severe infestations can cause leaf drop
management: Use appropriate locally approved pest-management methods
Follow product labels when using control products

Target_Spot.name: Target Spot
Target_Spot.description: A fungal disease that can cause circular brown lesions on tomato foliage and other plant tissues.
management: Use locally approved fungicides according to their labels

Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: A viral disease that can cause leaf curling, yellowing, and reduced plant growth.
symptoms: Smaller leaves and reduced fruit production
management: Remove severely infected plants where appropriate
Control insect vectors such as whiteflies
Use locally recommended integrated pest-management practices
prevention: Control weeds that may harbor vectors

Tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato Mosaic Virus
Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: A viral disease that can cause mottled leaf coloration and reduced plant growth.
symptoms: Light and dark green mosaic patterns
management: Avoid handling healthy plants after infected plants

healthy.description: The model detected a tomato leaf without the disease classes represented in its training data.
